lifecycle_blocker.assessment: The strongest current hypothesis is direct-ROCr queue/IB/signal or GPU-visible allocation create/drop churn, because fresh packed-dot passes and a one-graph Qwen soak survives more dispatches while avoiding repeated graph construction. The fault signature has appeared in two orchestrations, but exact-command repeatability and a fixed threshold are not yet established. Root ownership is not yet proven between Redline core, Hipfire adapters, ROCr, and amdgpu.
lifecycle_blocker.policy: Process isolation is a benchmark workaround only. Do not silently monkeypatch, retry after a page fault, accept native-shadow fallback, or default-enable Redline; minimize and seek an upstream lifecycle fix.

external_sanity_check.assessment: The W7900 same-HSACO medians are 19.3% and 18.6% above the report and win 12/16 more rows respectively. The separate dispatch controls bracket the reported 6.88x. Hardware, ROCm, and harness differences prevent treating these deltas as a regression or universal uplift.
